summary: Hosts on IPv6-only networks that use IPv4-IPv6 translation need to know the NAT64 prefix used to build synthesized addresses. This informational document gives guidelines for discovering that prefix, recommending that it be obtained from the Router Advertisement option described in RFC 8781.

eli5.summary: If you want to reach someone in another country, you need the right dialing code. This tells devices the best way to learn the code their network uses.
